QUOTE: It refuses first if the process predates its source (`stale_code_refusal`, returning `REFUSED:` and `code` in the reply). It then takes the per-repo build lock and re-checks freshness inside it
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the refresh write path refuses (not warns) on a stale code axis, and that this check happens first, before the build lock and freshness re-check. That matches the "ahead of the build decision" part. The answer never mentions a force flag, so it gives no direct evidence that force cannot override the refusal.
